senses.gloss:
mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Black, dark, of a dark or black colour.
m. (-कः)
1 Black or dark-blue, (the colour.)
2 The eye of a peacock's tail.
3 A cloud.
4 Smoke.
5 A plant, (Hyperanthera morunga.)
mn. (-कः-कं)
Darkness.
n. (-कं)
Sulphuret of antimony.
E.
मच to mix, Uṇādi aff. वुन्, and the vowel changed to ए.

f. (-गा)
The Yamunā river.
E.
मेचक dark, and अपगा the river.
